title: ledum palustre f. denudatum
intro: Ledum palustre f. denudatum, commonly known as bog Labrador tea, is a subspecies of the Ledum palustre plant, a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to northern Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of bog Labrador tea include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ledum palustre f. denudatum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
